podcast.title: Connection to Johnny Rotten
podcast.body: She became friends with Johnny Rotten, and it was through Ari that Johnny met and eventually married her mother, Nora. "They roamed the same circles as the Sex Pistols. Johnny and Ari became friends. They were contemporaries. Johnny met mom through Ari."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Daughter of Nora and Stepdaughter of Johnny Rotten
podcast.body: Ari is the daughter of Nora and the stepdaughter of Johnny Rotten. "He is, however, stepfather to Nora's daughter, Ari."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Rock Star Kids ｜ From the Archives

podcast.title: Punk Band Involvement
podcast.body: In the 1970s, Ari was a member of the punk band The Slits, moving in the same social circles as the Sex Pistols. "Back in the 1970s, Ari was in a punk band called The Slits."
